Taurox
Huge tracked carrier
AC 16 | HP 95 | DT 10 | Speed 60 ft | Handling 0
Crew 1 D, 1 G | Passengers 10 | Cargo 500 kg | Rare
Weapons: turret autocannon with Twin-Linked (G). Enclosed; two firing ports. Ignores difficult terrain from rubble and 
shallow mud. Ogryns use three passenger spaces; normal crew stations are human-sized.
